title: Rungrado 1st of May Stadium

terrainReference.basis: Original public elevation on the south apron beyond the mapped outer stadium.

mapIdentity.scope: The native stadium envelope contains 154 perimeter vertices. A separate mapped pitch ring provides the alignment and dimensions for the open bowl.

note: The exact Qualla crop supports the hanging pale roof silhouette and recessed facade. The eyewitness account records sixteen arches and the roof zenith at 60 metres. The unaltered Copernicus surface field includes the island, rivers and parts of the real roof.
